[RTCT.6.5] **Load-time refusal.** A runtime loading a `.dsc`
whose dialect resolves `realtime`:

  - MUST find a `RealtimeContract` atom; absence is
    `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_MISSING`.
  - MUST decode the body without error;
    `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID` on malformed payload.
  - MUST cross-check the embedded `rt_config_sha256` against
    a recomputation over the **materialized logical contract**
    ([RBND.4b.8]) — for the compact encoding ([RTCT.6.7]) this
    means expanding `default_node_cap`/`node_overrides`/
    `node_caps_packed` to the per-node list first; mismatch is
    `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`.
  - MUST cross-check the embedded `rt_config_sha256` against
    `DscHeader.rt_config_sha256` (the binding-spine
    duplicate); mismatch is `DS_ERR_BND_INCOMPLETE`.
